items.description:
JFK Xpert Solutions and Consultancy is an information technology company built around giving businesses a single technology partner for strategy and delivery. Its services span business analysis, business development and business intelligence, alongside custom and system development, mobile and website development, graphic design, staff training, cloud solutions and DevOps consultancy, covering a client's technology needs from planning through to ongoing support.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Tshwane, the self-owned consultancy has grown an international outlook on top of its local roots, and is listed on LinkedIn with a workforce of between 11 and 50 people. It suits businesses wanting to streamline their operations, strengthen their digital systems or plan a longer-term technology project rather than a once-off fix. The consultancy operates from Hardekool Avenue in Heuweloord, Centurion, serving clients across the wider Tshwane region.

JGF General Steel Works is a metal fabrication company based in Olievenhoutbosch, producing custom balustrades, security gates, palisade fencing, bull gates, burglar bars and doors, and carports for households and businesses. The company also manufactures trailers, window frames and sign boards, alongside a dedicated painting service for finished steelwork and security gates.

The business says it has built its reputation through continuous testing using the latest fabrication techniques, tailoring each job to a project's specific requirements and referencing its products against international standards. JGF frames its approach around enforcing security and delivering timely solutions, backed by a quality guarantee on completed work. Based in Olievenhoutbosch, Centurion, the company serves homeowners and businesses needing custom security gates, fencing, carports or general steelwork fabricated to order rather than bought off the shelf.

JPM Digital is a marketing agency in Equestria that works as a growth partner rather than a conventional digital agency, helping established local businesses turning over more than R200,000 a month build more predictable sales within 90 days. Instead of offering generic marketing services, the business built a 3-Step Predictable Sales Engine around fixing sales leaks first, then filling a client's pipeline with qualified leads, and finally turning satisfied clients into repeat business and referrals.

Its systems include lead capture into a single system, pipeline tracking across new, lost and follow-up stages, and a structured follow-up method combining SMS, WhatsApp and email. JPM Digital says its approach is built on data from over 2 million leads and more than R3 billion in estimated client sales, working inside a business's own sales process rather than only running adverts. Based in Equestria, Pretoria, the agency serves established local businesses wanting more predictable sales rather than just more marketing spend.

Juels Towing Services Pretoria provides 24/7 towing and roadside assistance across Gauteng from its base in Parktown Estate, handling flatbed and tow-truck recovery for cars, bakkies and SUVs alongside local call-outs and long-distance recovery. Most insurance providers are covered, with the company handling accident recovery and claim-friendly paperwork so customers do not have to manage the insurance side themselves.

Beyond towing, the business dispatches for breakdown assistance and jump-starts when a vehicle will not start on the road, and says it is fully equipped with modern flatbeds and recovery gear for jobs of any size. The company has built a 5-star rating from 24 Google reviews since launching its current booking system. Operating around the clock, every day of the year, from Parktown Estate, Pretoria, Juels Towing serves drivers across Gauteng needing fast, insurance-friendly recovery whether they have broken down locally or need a long-distance tow.

Just Sell Properties is an owner-managed real estate agency with more than 20 years of experience and over 30 agents working across Pretoria and Centurion, including listings in Booysens. The agency handles both residential and commercial sales and rentals, with its Booysens-area listings including apartment rentals such as those at Brooks Field Manor on Boekenhoutkloof Street.

Its website gives prospective tenants and buyers tools including area profiles, property calculators, and email alerts for new properties matching a saved search, alongside a free online comparative market assessment for homeowners wanting to know what their property is worth. Based in Booysens, Pretoria, Just Sell Properties serves buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants across the city looking for an established, owner-managed agency rather than a single-branch independent operator.

K. Carrim Group Holdings is a family-owned hardware and building materials business dating back to 1964, trading from Boom Street in Pretoria Central through a group of specialised trading companies. Builders Mecca serves the DIY and retail construction market, Wholesale Hardware supplies building hardware, tiles and sanitaryware at bulk pricing, and Exclusive Bathroom & Tiles offers 3D conceptual design support for customers planning a full bathroom renovation.

The group's Tiles & Sanitaryware division imports a wide range of accessories for bathroom design, while its Soft Collection covers tapware and sanitaryware ranging from contemporary to more traditional styles. K. Carrim Residential Properties, a subsidiary of the group, designs and builds residential developments, and the group runs its own fleet and logistics operation for door-to-door delivery of everything from tiles to bulk loads, alongside its own online store. Based in Pretoria Central, K. Carrim Group Holdings serves homeowners, trade customers and property buyers across the city.

Kaysies Discounters is a discount retailer in East Lynne stocking a wide mix of goods rather than sticking to a single product line, with categories spanning appliances, audio and visual equipment, furniture, bicycles, camping gear, car sound and catering and wedding equipment. Its appliance range covers everyday items such as kettles, irons, steam presses and vacuum cleaners through to larger goods including front-loader washing machines and LED televisions.

The store also stocks cleaning materials alongside its general retail range, giving customers a single discount destination for household goods that might otherwise need several separate trips to different specialist stores. Based on Baviaanspoort Road in East Lynne, Pretoria, Kaysies Discounters serves households across the area looking for discounted appliances, furniture and general goods from a wide-ranging stockist rather than a narrow specialist retailer.

KFC Jubilee Mall is a branch of the KFC fast-food chain, serving the fried chicken meals, burgers, wraps, buckets, sides and beverages the brand is known for, prepared for eating in or taking away. Orders can be placed in-store, through the KFC app, or through delivery partners, and the branch also caters for groups wanting a larger order collected or delivered together.

The branch trades from Shop 72 in Jubilee Mall, on the corner of Jubilee Road and Harry Gwala Avenue in Hammanskraal, Gauteng, staying open until 21:00 each day. It offers both in-store collection and home delivery, making it a convenient stop for shoppers already at the mall as well as households nearby wanting a quick meal without a long wait.

Kiowa Spur Steak Ranch is a branch of the long-running Spur Steak Ranches family restaurant chain, serving the group's familiar steaks, ribs, burgers, wings and grills alongside breakfast, lunch and dinner menus. Children are catered for with their own meals, and the restaurant keeps a play area and facilities for children's parties, making it a practical choice for family outings as well as everyday dining.

Desserts round out the menu for those staying to eat in, and the restaurant also offers delivery for customers who would rather eat at home. It trades from Shop 1 in Centurion Lifestyle Centre on Lenchen Avenue, Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion, open Monday to Thursday from 07:00 to 21:00, Friday and Saturday from 07:00 to 22:00, and Sunday from 08:00 to 21:00.

La Montagne Pharmacy is an independent community pharmacy that has provided pharmacy services in La Montagne for more than 24 years. The pharmacy operates a medicine depot, a service designed for areas without a stand-alone pharmacy, where customers can drop off written prescriptions and later collect dispensed, compounded or supplied medication once it has been prepared by a pharmacist.

As an independent operator rather than part of a national pharmacy chain, the business serves a smaller community catchment directly from its Albertus Street premises. Trading Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and closed on weekends and public holidays, La Montagne Pharmacy serves residents of La Montagne and the surrounding area who need prescriptions dispensed and collected locally rather than travelling to a larger pharmacy elsewhere in the city.

Label Solutions is a family-run South African label and printing equipment supplier in Lyttelton Manor with more than 30 years in the industry, specialising in high-quality, custom label printing that blends precision, creativity and sustainability. The business offers tamper-proof security labels and high-performance linerless labels, alongside label printers, consumables and technical support for customers running their own in-house labelling.

Its products are built around environmentally conscious materials, with the company framing every label as a small step toward more sustainable packaging. Label Solutions says its reputation rests on fast turnaround times, reliable service and tailor-made solutions built around each client's specific labelling needs, whether that means custom barcodes or a complete labelling system. Based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, the company serves businesses across South Africa needing labelling products and equipment supported by ongoing technical service.

LDR International is a consulting firm in Lyttelton organised into three specialised divisions working together to support business growth. Its core LDR International division covers strategic planning, leadership development, business performance, growth strategy and executive coaching, helping organisations build sustainable performance through clearer strategy and stronger leadership.

A second division, LDR Media, handles digital growth and brand solutions including website development, social media management, SEO optimisation, content creation and wider digital marketing. A third division, Inner Life Story, supports individual clients through personal growth and purpose development, extending the firm's work from organisational consulting into individual coaching. Based in Lyttelton, Centurion, LDR International serves businesses and individuals wanting strategic, digital and personal development support from one consulting group.

LEAF Quality Systems (Pty) Ltd works with audit firms and individual auditors to raise audit quality beyond basic regulatory compliance, based at Southdowns Ridge Office Park in Irene, Centurion. The firm's divisions cover audit quality, financial reporting, global regulation and training, aiming to help firms build quality systems that regulators trust and clients have confidence in.

LEAF says its work responds directly to pressures auditors face from regulatory findings, negative press about the profession and uninformed client questioning, aiming to restore a sense of pride in auditing as a career. Its online learning platform, LEAF Quest, gives both experienced and newly qualified auditors a way to build skills and stay current with regulatory change. Based in Southdowns, Centurion, LEAF Quality Systems serves audit firms and individual auditors across South Africa's audit and public finance sectors.

Legis IT Solutions is a managed IT services provider in Eldoraigne that has kept South African businesses running since 2008, supporting everything from five-user practices to 300-user operations across local and international clients with a presence in Gauteng. The company offers unlimited on-site and remote support alongside proactive 24/7 monitoring designed to catch problems before a client notices them.

Its vendor partnerships include Microsoft, Fortinet, SentinelOne and Redstor, giving clients established, properly configured platforms for networking, cybersecurity and cloud backup rather than whatever happens to be cheapest. Legis also helps businesses deploy AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude securely and in a POPIA-compliant way. Based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, and managing more than 1,500 devices across its client base, Legis IT Solutions serves businesses needing day-to-day IT support alongside modern cybersecurity and AI adoption.

Life Brooklyn Day Hospital is a 27-bed private day hospital in Brooklyn, Pretoria, specialising in plastic and reconstructive surgery alongside smaller day surgery procedures, with an overnight facility available for more complex cases. Its surgeons are registered with the Association of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons of South Africa and perform facial surgery including facelifts, eyelid lifts, and ear and nose reshaping, alongside body surgery such as breast enlargements, reductions and lifts.

Body contouring procedures cover liposuction, tummy tucks and the removal of excess skin from the back, buttocks, abdomen, thighs and waist, and the hospital also treats vascular malformations and birthmarks. A separate maxillo-facial and oral surgery service treats a range of head, neck, face and jaw conditions, including dento-facial deformity correction and dental implants. Based in Brooklyn, Pretoria, the hospital offers pricing structured for both private and medical aid patients.

Linqit Solutions is a BBBEE Level 1 accredited ICT consulting firm in Eldo Lakes Estate, Centurion, and a certified SYSPRO ERP partner specialising in enterprise resource planning, systems integration, warehouse management and business intelligence for manufacturers and distributors. Its SYSPRO ERP implementation work covers a client's full supply chain from procurement through to distribution.

Beyond SYSPRO, Linqit offers Flowgear for no-code and low-code cloud system integration, Translution for real-time warehouse management and inventory accuracy, and Zap Data Hub for centralising data and automating reporting and dashboards. The company also works with Laserfiche for document management, giving clients a wider set of specialist platforms alongside its core ERP work. Based in Centurion, Linqit Solutions serves manufacturers and distributors needing ERP, integration and business intelligence solutions tailored to their operations.

Little Jungle Indoor Playground is an indoor play facility at Montana Boulevard Lifestyle Centre in Magalieskruin for children aged 6 months to 10 years, with dedicated safe zones for toddlers and older children to play at their own pace. The venue features multi-level jungle gyms, bridges and tunnels alongside ball pits and slides, with a parents' lounge where adults can relax with a coffee while keeping an eye on the play area.

Playtime is charged per child, with a lower weekday rate from Tuesday to Thursday and a higher rate over weekends and public holidays, while accompanying adults enter free of charge. The venue also hosts birthday parties, handling the entertainment side of a party while parents focus on their guests, and maintains the space with regular deep cleaning. Based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, Little Jungle serves families across the area looking for supervised indoor play or a birthday party venue for young children.

Lizmar Books Monument Park is a secondhand bookstore and book exchange trading from the Monument Park Shopping Centre, selling everything from collector's editions to the newest bestsellers. Customers who bring in books they no longer want receive 25% credit toward their next purchase, letting regular readers keep cycling through new titles without paying full price each time.

The shop operates as a genuine exchange rather than a straight secondhand retailer, meaning its stock changes regularly as customers bring in and take out books. Trading Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturdays until 2pm, Lizmar Books serves readers across Monument Park and the surrounding suburbs who want an affordable way to read widely without buying every title new.

LMI, short for Libra Measuring Instruments, is a Waltloo-based manufacturer of electronic weighing and scale systems founded in 1985, designing and developing complete weighing systems from the structure and electronics through to the software. Its product range spans weighbridges, livestock scales, silo scales, platform scales, in-motion railway scales, auction scales, feeder mixer scales, group-axle scales and crane hanging scales.

The company's best-known project is its axle weigher for mine vehicles, capable of handling loads of up to 400 tons, installed at Kumba Iron Ore in 2007 and still in operation. LMI positions itself as a leader in the design and development of electronic scales in South Africa, offering custom-built systems rather than only standard models. Based in Waltloo, Pretoria, the company serves mines, farms, grain handlers and industrial sites across the region needing weighing systems built to their specific requirements.

Lockhat Incorporated is a technology-driven auditing and accounting firm in Zwartkop, Centurion, that has grown into one of the fastest-growing firms in its sector, now operating three branches across South Africa with more than 80 full-time employees. Its audit process is built around digesting the risks that rapid technological change brings to a client's financial performance, with Adaptive Audit and Attestation Services designed to evolve alongside emerging areas such as intellectual property, alliances and e-business.

Beyond audit work, the firm provides non-audit accounting services through a specified partner, and serves clients ranging from family businesses and high-net-worth individuals to business valuation and property management mandates. Lockhat Incorporated positions its service around being consistently available to clients working through a problem, rather than only during scheduled reviews. Based in Zwartkop, Centurion, the firm serves businesses and individuals across South Africa needing auditing, accounting and related advisory services.

Log Home Timbers supplies construction and purpose-built timber products from branches in Pretoria, Vanderbijlpark and Bloemfontein, describing itself as the leading timber supplier across the three regions. Its range includes wet-off-saw and structural timber, pine profiles, treated poles, framing timber and decking timber, used in projects from simple decking jobs through to full log homes.

The company also supplies timber for Wendy houses, pergolas, carpentry, roofing, furniture, non-slip decking and fencing, alongside general hardware, giving builders and homeowners a wide timber range from a single supplier rather than sourcing different products from separate yards. Based in Heatherview, Akasia, Log Home Timbers serves builders, contractors and homeowners across Pretoria and its other branch regions needing timber supplied and cut to project specification.

Logi-Ink is a Pretoria web development and digital agency offering custom websites and web applications, UI and UX design, brand strategy and digital marketing from its Constantia Park base. Landing pages start from R5,500 and full starter websites from R9,500, including VAT, giving clients fixed pricing before a project begins rather than an open-ended quote.

Its digital marketing work covers SEO services, Google Ads management and social media management, while its technical stack spans static HTML, modular CSS and vanilla JavaScript on the front end, alongside Shopify, WooCommerce and WordPress for stores and content management. Logi-Ink frames its brand around being the digital signature of a client's business, building sites intended to leave a lasting impression as well as rank and convert visitors. Based in Constantia Park, Pretoria, the agency serves small and medium businesses across South Africa needing a website built, hosted and marketed by one team.

LogicTrials SA is a clinical research services provider whose logistics division manages the clinical trial supply chain from a dedicated warehousing facility in Irene, handling the picking, checking, packing and temperature-controlled transport of clinical trial supplies. The company offers sponsors conducting trials in South Africa a centralised clinical trial supplies depot, backed by a team of healthcare professionals experienced in clinical research logistics.

Its inventory management covers receipt, storage and dispatch of investigational products through to returns, recalls, quarantine and destruction, with stock movement tracked through a perpetual inventory system reporting in real time. Temperature-controlled storage spans ambient conditions of 15 to 25 degrees Celsius and cold-chain conditions of 2 to 8 degrees Celsius, ensuring supplies stay within required ranges throughout the process. Based in Blue Valley Golf Estate, Centurion, LogicTrials SA serves clinical research organisations running trials across South Africa.

LPM Steel (Pty) Ltd has installed single, double and multiple pitched carports and gazebos across domestic, industrial and commercial sites in the greater Centurion area since 2003, including carports at Centurion Mall. Beyond carports, the company designs and fabricates security cages built to protect a property without compromising on durability or finish.

The business frames its approach around professionalism, precision and pride in every project, aiming to complete work safely, on time and to a high standard given the investment clients put into their properties. LPM Steel positions its value around experienced hands and honest advice, offering guidance on materials and design before a project starts rather than only quoting on a fixed brief. Based in Clubview, Centurion, the company serves homeowners and businesses across the area needing carports, gazebos or security steelwork installed by an established local fabricator.

Lubbes Trust (Pty) Ltd is a fiduciary partner in Montana, Pretoria, specialising in the comprehensive drafting of wills and the planning and administration of estates and trusts, drawing on more than a century of combined experience across its team. The firm's core service portfolio covers wills, estates and trusts, built around understanding each client's unique circumstances rather than applying a standard template to every matter.

Through added services, clients also get access to Burmeister Attorneys Inc for wider legal work and Lubbes Trust Accounting Services for accounting support, giving fiduciary clients a connected set of related professional services rather than needing to find separate providers. Based in Montana, Pretoria, and trading Monday to Thursday and Friday mornings, Lubbes Trust serves individuals and families across the region needing wills, estate planning or trust administration handled with long-standing fiduciary expertise.

Mahuma Group is a multidimensional media and communications agency that has worked with clients ranging from luxury brands and retailers to banks and boutique businesses since 2005, with an additional office in Polokwane, Limpopo. The agency's service lines span media, events, production, consulting, infrastructure and communication, built organically through recommendations and word-of-mouth rather than a large marketing budget of its own.

Mahuma Group is 100% proudly South African with a Level 1 B-BBEE contributor status, and runs community social initiatives based on a back-to-basics principle, engaging communities in social-upliftment projects where it operates on a day-to-day basis. The agency frames its creative work around capturing hearts, inspiring minds and delivering measurable business results for clients. Based in Zwartkop, Centurion, Mahuma Group serves established brands and boutique businesses across sectors needing media, events and communications work handled by one agency.

Makro Centurion is a large one-stop retail warehouse store in Highveld, Centurion, stocking home entertainment, computers and communications equipment alongside office furniture and stationery. Its range extends into appliances, hardware and DIY supplies, home decor, and food and liquor, giving shoppers a single warehouse-format store covering most household and small-business buying needs.

As part of the wider Makro chain, the Centurion store is listed on retail directories alongside its nearby sister branches in Highveld, Pretoria West and Johannesburg, and regularly features in the chain's weekly specials and promotional catalogues. Based at Bloukrans Road in Highveld, Centurion, Makro Centurion serves households, small businesses and bulk buyers across the area looking for a broad product range under one roof rather than visiting several specialist retailers.

Marius Blom Inc. is a boutique Pretoria law firm with more than 40 years of experience, recognised as a national leader in liquor licensing law, handling new liquor licence applications, manufacturing and wholesale liquor licences, transfers, renewals and occasional or temporary licences from its Waterkloof Glen offices. The firm also runs a general litigation practice, representing clients in High Court, Magistrates' Court and tribunal disputes.

Its property and conveyancing team supports clients buying, selling or leasing property, while a separate SARS customs and excise service handles customs disputes, detentions, tariff classifications and excise compliance. The firm describes itself as rewarding and promoting talent solely on merit, aiming to deliver unrivalled value for money by running its business the way its clients run theirs. Based in Constantia Park, Pretoria, Marius Blom Inc. serves general, commercial and liquor-industry clients needing litigation, property or regulatory legal support.

Mark Efstratiou Incorporated is a Pretoria law firm specialising in landlord and tenant law, built on more than 27 years of practice serving landlords throughout South Africa. The firm's success rests on the speed of its service, personal attention to each client's matter, and common-sense legal and commercial advice aimed at the client's ultimate benefit rather than unnecessary litigation.

Existing clients also get access to free workshops and lectures covering the law of landlord and tenant, the legal process involved in disputes, and the typical problem areas landlords, their employees and property management companies encounter in lease agreements. The practice prioritises developing long-term relationships with clients over one-off transactional work. Based in Hazeldean, Pretoria, the firm serves landlords and property management companies across South Africa needing dedicated landlord-tenant legal advice rather than a general practice.

Marketing Support Services is a creative marketing agency in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, with a team of 17 staff and in-house production capabilities covering web and digital work, video production, print and branding, and broader creative design. The agency positions itself as big enough to handle any job but small enough that clients still get a high level of personal quality and service.

Its process runs from an initial meeting and project briefing through ideation and the presentation of initial concepts, followed by client feedback and a limited round of revisions before final sign-off and delivery, with maintenance and support continuing afterward. Working from the address it calls the house with the red wall in Ashlea Gardens, Marketing Support Services serves clients across Pretoria wanting branding, print and digital creative work handled through a structured, collaborative process.

Masston Group is a multi-disciplinary engineering construction company in Lynnwood Glen drawing on more than 40 years of combined team experience, positioning itself as a construction management, property development and facilities management partner. The group operates through several divisions, including Masston Construction Projects, Maanda Dimension Consulting, Norezani Investments, Oriduko Security Services and Mugovheli Logistics, giving it capability across construction, consulting, security and logistics under one group structure.

Masston Group frames its objectives around alleviating poverty in disadvantaged communities by creating job opportunities, encouraging the transfer of skills, and using SABS-approved and, where possible, green building materials. The group works with government, developer and investor clients to deliver landmark real estate projects intended to add lasting value to both investors and the communities it builds in. Based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, Masston Group serves clients needing construction, property development or facilities management delivered by a single, multi-divisional partner.

Maxi Security's Riviera office has served the Pretoria area since the company was established in 1991, offering armed response, CCTV, alarm systems, access control and gate automation to corporate, retail, industrial and other clients. The company now offers an AI-augmented guarding solution alongside traditional guarding, aiming to improve service quality while giving clients a cost benefit over guarding alone.

A majority Black-owned subsidiary, Maxi Phumelela Security, was established in 2001 as part of the group's empowerment structure, and the wider group achieved Level 1 B-BBEE accreditation in 2019. Maxi Security runs a 24/7, 365-day control room and call centre supporting a national footprint of corporate, retail, industrial, warehousing, wholesale and gaming clients, as well as metropolitan councils and parastatal organisations. Based in Riviera, Pretoria, the company serves businesses across the region needing security guarding, monitoring and response backed by a long-established national provider.

MDS Collivery Pretoria is a branch of the MDS Collivery courier network, providing express courier and logistics services to businesses and individuals. Its offering covers intra-city, same-day and nationwide deliveries, backed by the logistical support that comes from operating through an established network of branches across the country.

The wider network was founded in 1991 as an intra-city courier service and has since grown into a full express courier operation, with the MDS Group now running a fleet of more than 200 vehicles and employing over 300 people nationally. The Pretoria branch operates from Vonkprop Road in Samcor Park, Pretoria, serving customers across the city and surrounding region who need reliable, trackable deliveries.

Melamed Construction, established in 2002 and based in Pretoria, builds new houses and facilities as well as renovations and additions, running its own building, plastering, electrical and painting teams alongside an engineer for concrete slab and structural work. In 2008 the company helped a BEE organisation, Fabcos Construction, with project management and construction on certain sites, with empowerment a key focus of that project.

The company uses the documentation and building contracts provided by the Master Builder Association, protecting both client and contractor on every job, and offers public liability insurance where a client requires it. Melamed Construction also offers TLB hire as a separate service alongside its core building work. Based in Pretoria and serving the Midstream Estate area, the company serves homeowners and developers needing new builds, renovations or structural work handled by its own in-house teams rather than subcontracted trades.

Meyer & Partners Attorneys has operated from Eldoraigne, Centurion since being established in 2008, with additional offices in the Western Cape and consistent five-star ratings on Google and other review platforms. The firm serves individuals and corporate clients across industries including manufacturing, staffing services, retail, hospitality and entertainment, working across labour law, the law of contract, criminal and civil law, family law and conveyancing.

As a full-service firm, Meyer & Partners aims to be experienced enough to meet corporate clients' demands while staying agile enough to give private clients the same level of personal attention, tailoring its advice to each client's specific industry or personal circumstances. Based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, the firm serves businesses and individuals across Centurion, Pretoria and Johannesburg needing legal advice across a broad span of commercial and personal matters from one practice.

MG Executive Protection Services, founded by two partners with a military background, provides VIP and witness protection, asset protection, private investigations, guarding and chauffeur services from its headquarters in Karenpark, Akasia. Clients needing to move discreetly or quickly can also arrange helicopter and private jet hire through the company, extending its protection work into transport logistics for high-risk or high-profile travel.

The business runs separate consultation and support lines so that new enquiries and existing clients needing assistance are handled through different channels. Trading Monday to Friday from 8am to 7pm and Saturday mornings, MG Executive Protection Services serves corporate, private and high-net-worth clients across Gauteng needing personal protection, investigation or secure transport arranged by a single security provider.

MGT Accounting and Consulting Inc, founded in 2015, is a 100% Black-owned firm in Pretoria North specialising in external and internal auditing, bookkeeping, tax and business advisory services for private, public-sector and donor-funded clients across South Africa. Its service range extends into financial statements, HR administration, payroll, tax and SARS administration, secretarial consulting, and trusts and estates, covering most of the administrative and compliance work a growing organisation needs.

The firm positions integrity as central to its work, holding to high ethical and governance standards and staying current with industry developments through membership of professional accounting organisations. MGT frames its reputation around serving established businesses and government entities with comprehensive audit, accounting and consulting support rather than a narrow bookkeeping service. Based in Pretoria North, the firm serves private, public-sector and donor-funded clients needing accounting and advisory services handled to a formal professional standard.

Micro Robotics (Pty) Ltd, headquartered at Highveld Techno Park, is an electronics and robotics supplier and official distributor for Arduino, Adafruit, Sparkfun, Pololu, DF Robot, Teensy and Wantai, and has since expanded with a further store in Stellenbosch. Its catalogue covers development boards and sensors such as air-quality sensors reporting PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 particle concentrations, alongside basic components including resistors sold in bulk packs for hobbyist and professional electronics work.

Stock is tracked separately across its Centurion store, Stellenbosch store and a bulk location, letting customers check availability at each site before ordering. Micro Robotics serves students, hobbyists and professionals building electronics projects who need components ranging from basic resistors to complete development boards. Based at Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, the company serves customers across South Africa through its physical stores and online ordering.

Midas Silverlakes, based in the Silver Oaks Crossing shopping centre, stocks a comprehensive range of auto parts and accessories for the local motoring community, including motorbike spares and accessories alongside its usual car parts. As a member of the Retail Motor Industry Organisation, the branch forms part of a recognised national network of motor parts and service outlets rather than operating as an unaffiliated independent store.

Customers can source parts across most common vehicle makes through the branch rather than needing to visit a brand-specific dealer parts counter for routine maintenance items. Trading seven days a week, with Sunday as its only closed day, Midas Silverlakes serves motorists and motorbike owners across the Silver Lakes and wider Pretoria East area needing parts for a service, repair or upgrade.

MLS Brokers has operated as an insurance brokerage in Doornpoort, Pretoria since August 1999, placing commercial short-term insurance alongside personal and life cover from the same office. The practice's centre of gravity is commercial short-term cover for concrete mixers, plant and engineering risks and transport, insuring equipment such as ready-mix trucks, boom pumps, batch plants and cement tankers that earn their keep on site and in the yard.

Beyond its specialist commercial lines, MLS Brokers places cover for specialist liabilities, agricultural risk and broader commercial and business insurance, alongside personal lines, life insurance and retirement planning. As a licensed financial service provider under the FAIS Act since 1999, the brokerage frames its approach around a broker phoning the client personally once a claim or query comes in, rather than routing it through a call-centre queue. Based in Doornpoort, Pretoria, MLS Brokers serves commercial and personal clients across the region needing specialist and general insurance cover from one broking practice.

items.reason: Insufficient reliable information to verify the architectural/interior-design services offered: the company's website remains unavailable, showing a 'site undergoing maintenance' placeholder on every path tried, and the supplied Magalieskruin address could not be reliably connected to a current authoritative source. Held for a deeper pass rather than published on unverified facts.

items.description:
Mondanette Butchery, in Monument Park Shopping Centre, is a Pretoria butchery with a legacy dating back to 1983, offering fresh cuts, specialty sausages and delicacies alongside a dedicated game meat processing department. Its range extends across beef, lamb, pork, chicken, offal, mince and patties, biltong and droewors, boerewors and sausages, and ready-to-braai deli items, giving customers most of what a braai or weekly shop needs from one counter.

The butchery delivers across Pretoria within a 20km radius, with orders placed before 11am delivered the next day and later orders delivered within 48 hours; delivery costs R50 for orders under R800 and is free above that amount. Customers can pay by EFT or through a secure Payfast gateway, and receive email confirmation once an order and payment have gone through. Based in Monument Park, Pretoria, Mondanette Butchery serves households across the city wanting fresh meat and braai essentials delivered to the door or collected in person.

Monlu Signs is a Pretoria signage company established in 1990, specialising in vehicle signage, digital printing, roll-up banners, car magnetics, banners and stickers from its Meyerspark base. Its range extends to aluminium and steel letters and logos, hazmat signs, chromadek boards, silkscreen printing and construction boards made to exact specification from architect drawings, used by both civil and building contractors.

The company also produces correx and estate agent boards, a screen-printed format it describes as one of the most effective advertising formats available, along with truck signage that turns a vehicle into a mobile billboard, and window signage for shopfronts. Monlu Signs positions its offering around quality signage at affordable Pretoria prices rather than premium big-city rates. Based in Meyerspark, Pretoria, the company serves contractors, estate agents and businesses across the city needing signage produced and installed locally.

Nambiti Technologies is a Black-owned ICT services company established in 1997, holding Level 1 BBBEE status with a 135% BBBEE scorecard, and has built operational offices in all nine provinces of South Africa. The company provides SAP implementation and support, network design, Microsoft SharePoint, Oracle and IT security services to public and private sector clients.

Beyond traditional ICT services, Nambiti has moved into Fourth Industrial Revolution work, including artificial intelligence combining large data volumes with fast, iterative processing, robotics design and operation, and Internet of Things systems that connect and exchange data between devices, developed using high-level languages such as Swift and C++. Based in Clubview, Centurion, Nambiti Technologies serves public and private sector clients across South Africa needing established ICT services alongside newer AI, robotics and IoT capability.

NatRent Rentals offers flexible, month-to-month office space from 15 to 50 square metres in a secure Willow Park Manor business complex on Havelock Road, with 24-hour access and security and free WiFi included. Tenants also get access to networking events and business training sessions run through the complex, giving small businesses and freelancers a professional base with some of the community benefits of a larger co-working space.

The office space forms part of NatRent's wider property rental and management operation across southern Gauteng, which handles both residential and commercial lettings and prides itself on efficient, transparent, people-focused service for landlords and tenants alike. Based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria East, NatRent Rentals serves small businesses, freelancers and growing teams needing flexible office space without committing to a long-term lease.

Ndlovu Lodge is a guest lodge offering a range of accommodation types, from standard, premium and family rooms through to luxury suites, each fitted with private facilities, toiletries, a desk, tea and coffee facilities and a bar refrigerator. A number of rooms also have their own fireplace, and ironing and laundry facilities are available to guests for the length of their stay.

Rated as a 4-star establishment, the lodge has its own restaurant and can accommodate up to 36 guests at a time, making it suited to both individual travellers and small groups. It is located on Zwavelpoort Road in Pretoria East, Pretoria, offering a quiet base for guests visiting the wider Pretoria area.

Nouvelle Ere Beauty Spa & Boutique Guesthouse combines boutique overnight accommodation with an on-site day spa. Guest rooms are private and en-suite, fitted with air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, a work desk and a television, with breakfast included, while the spa side of the business offers massages, facials, pedicures and other beauty treatments for guests and day visitors alike.

The guesthouse also provides free private parking, a swimming pool, garden and terrace, and puts together spa-and-stay packages that pair overnight accommodation and breakfast with an optional massage treatment. It is based on Panorama Road in The Reeds, Centurion, and suits guests looking to combine a short stay with some time spent being pampered.

Novagen Pharma is an independently owned pharmaceutical company established in 2009 that markets a range of generic antiretroviral and chronic medication products, ranking among the largest private suppliers of ARVs in South Africa. Its product range spans antibiotics, antiretrovirals, and medicines for balance disorders, cardiovascular conditions, central nervous system disorders, cholesterol management, diabetes and osteoporosis.

The company maintains a dedicated adverse event reporting channel for patients and healthcare providers, reflecting its registration as a formal pharmaceutical manufacturer rather than an unregulated generics importer. Novagen frames its approach around the right medicine reaching the right patient at the right time, a principle it applies across its wellness and chronic medication ranges alike. Based at Route 21 Corporate Park in Irene, Pretoria, Novagen Pharma serves pharmacies, clinics and patients across South Africa needing affordable generic chronic and ARV medication.

Nutec Wendy Homes builds custom nutec houses, cottages and Wendy houses using cement-fibre board over solid timber frames, serving Pretoria North, West, East and Central, Centurion, Montana, Doornpoort, Sinoville and Akasia alongside Johannesburg, Sandton, Midrand and Soweto. The company builds single-room structures through to full 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom nutec homes, along with granny flats, rental cottages, offices and studios for landlords and small business owners.

The business positions nutec construction against traditional wooden or corrugated-iron Wendy houses, which it says warp, leak and rot especially in Gauteng's storms, whereas nutec cladding can be painted any colour and gives better insulation. Combined with ceilings, proper windows, plumbing and electrical points, a finished nutec home is built for full-time living rather than just extra storage space. Based in Florauna, Pretoria North, Nutec Wendy Homes serves families, landlords and small business owners across Gauteng needing a permanent structure built to order.

This is the Oasis Water franchise administrative office, based at Boardwalk Office Park in Faerie Glen, serving the Oasis Water network of more than 400 outlets across South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Eswatini and Lesotho. Oasis Water itself produces reverse-osmosis purified water, bottled in what the brand describes as an eco-friendly and affordable format sold through its outlet network rather than through general retail alone.

As the franchise's administrative office rather than a retail outlet itself, the Boardwalk Manor site handles franchise support and network administration behind the outlets that customers visit directly. Based in Faerie Glen, Pretoria, the office supports the wider Oasis Water franchise network across five Southern African countries, serving franchisees rather than walk-in retail customers.
